This '''war''' was waged among the [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]], an aggressive [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], and the [[ZeHethbra]], who came from the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[ZeHeth/Legends|ZeHeth]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

After joining the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the ZeHethbra started to travel through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonize]] several worlds.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref><ref name="UAE">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> While doing so, the ZeHethbra reached the [[Malastare system/Legends|Malastare system]] and began to establish settlements in the area.<ref name="NEGAS" />

The locals, known as Dugs, were a rude, insulting people prone to violence when angry &mdash; a trait that led them to several wars with other [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Dugs disliked their new neighbors and this eventually led to a war among the two species.<ref name="NEGAS" />

After this conflict and several other similar ones among Dugs and other species, the Galactic Republic, disapproving the Dug attitude, imposed a number of sanctions on the Dugs.<ref name="NEGAS" />
